name: realestate
title: Real estate site
description: A real estate site for a brokerage or a private office: two home pages (search first, or a full-bleed photograph), search with a list and a drawn map (filters, a drawn area, saved searches), listing pages with a photo viewer, tour booking, floor plan, schools and a payment calculator, agents, neighborhoods, a three-step valuation, a mortgage calculator, compare, saved homes, a journal, about and contact. Wears the installed DressCode theme in light and dark.
author: DressCode UI <https://dresscodeui.com>

// Everything the Real estate site says lives here: the brokerage, its city and neighborhoods, the
// listings, the agents, the journal and the market numbers. Swap them for yours; every page reads
// from this file. Photos are keys into PHOTOS (assets.ts); give a listing your own photo URLs there.
// HOME picks the home page: "platform" (search first, for a brokerage or a local portal) or
// "boutique" (a full-bleed photograph and a few homes, for a private office or a single agent).

export type Variant = "platform" | "boutique"
export const HOME: Variant = "platform"

export type Status = "sale" | "rent" | "sold"
export type HomeType = "House" | "Condo" | "Townhouse" | "Loft"
export type Badge = "New" | "Just listed" | "Price cut" | "Open house" | "Pending"

export type Listing = {
  slug: string
  address: string
  unit?: string
  hood: string
  /** Asking price, or the monthly rent when status is "rent". */
  price: number
  status: Status
  badge?: Badge
  /** "Sat 1–3 PM"; shows on the card and the page. */
  openHouse?: string
  beds: number
  baths: number
  sqft: number
  /** Acres. */
  lot?: number
  type: HomeType
  year: number
  parking: string
  heating: string
  cooling: string
  hoa?: number
  /** The one line on cards and in search results. */
  summary: string
  description: string[]
  features: string[]
  /** Photo keys (assets.ts), the first is the cover. */
  photos: string[]
  /** Where the pin sits on the map, in % of its width and height. */
  at: [number, number]
  agent: string
  /** ISO date it was listed. */
  listed: string
  history: [string, string, number][]
  /** Shown on the boutique home and with the private office's look. */
  private?: boolean
  /** Floors, for the drawn floor plan. */
  floors: 1 | 2
  /** What "More filters" matches on. */
  tags: Feature[]
}

Real estate site: the pages are in components/realestate/ and the routes are /realestate, /realestate/buy, /realestate/homes/<listing> and so on.
Make it yours in components/realestate/data.ts: the brokerage, its city and neighborhoods, the listings, agents and journal, and HOME ("platform" or "boutique").
The sample photographs load from dresscodeui.com; point the keys in components/realestate/assets.ts at your own photos.
It reads lib/dresscode-theme.ts, so install a DressCode theme first (any of the nine), e.g. npx shadcn@latest add https://dresscodeui.com/r/dresscode/mono.json
Built on shadcn/ui with Base UI (components.json style base-*): the menus and sheet use Base UI's render prop.
